items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Eat any qualifying Pre-war Food such as BlamCo Mac and Cheese or Dandy Boy Apples.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter in Free Cam
items.detail: Enter your shelter, open build menu, toggle free cam, place a decoration in the Decorations category, then scrap it.

items.title: Eat a Plant-based Meal
items.detail: Cook Corn Soup at a Cooking Station and consume it.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest plants or fungi from the wild or from farms such as Silva Homestead.

items.title: Kill a Creature while in a Team
items.detail: Join or create a team, then kill creatures such as Scorched.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms (masked cultists) inside an Infestation hotspot.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Pick up a Grunt Hunt bounty at Highway Town, then kill enemies with a melee weapon like Combat Knife or Fire Axe.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your shelter, access the build menu, select Decorations category, and place any decoration.

items.title: Buy an item from or Sell an item to another Player
items.detail: Visit another player's C.A.M.P. and buy or sell an item at their vendor.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Collect 2500 Caps from loot, containers, or by selling items to vendors.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Complete 3 Infestations by clearing the marked hotspots.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town and defeat the Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher that appears as a legendary phantom.

items.title: Kill a Mutated Enemy
items.detail: Kill 30 mutated enemies during Mutated Public Events or Daily Ops.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Kill 20 Pint-Sized Phantoms inside Infestation hotspots.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Creature
items.detail: Kill 5 Legendary creatures such as Legendary wolves from Leader of the Pack events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Special mutated variants of public events offer increased challenge and unique rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Earn experience points at double rate during this limited weekend event.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and starting Season 27 You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event returns with double mutation spawns for increased legendary drops.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Limited-time seasonal event featuring holiday-themed scorched enemies with unique rewards.
